pictures.name: DW1-Desert-Well
pictures.prompt: A hot desert road long ago at midday: heat shimmer over pale sand, a low ring of rough stones around an old well in the center, a few thorn bushes, cool shade inside the well’s dark mouth. Harsh light, lonely road. No people or human figures of any kind. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike, rich textiles and textures, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still. One tall 9:16 vertical picture, main subject in the middle. No text, no letters, no logos.
